generation: Built-in ImageGen edit of actual Blender renders

outline.measurement: Distance from opaque artwork to the 50% alpha boundary

portraits.name: Dusk Moth
portraits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make one transparent Roblox simulator pet UI portrait. Image 1 is the actual Blender render and the artwork to preserve. Keep its front-left three-quarter camera, cube body, shape, pose, exact appendage counts, soft 3D shading, and saturated colors. Subject: bright orchid-violet cube moth, two smooth round-tipped antennae, two rounded pairs of violet wings with a single large lilac oval on each upper wing, cream pink mask, violet glossy eyes and four tiny violet paws. Image 2 is only the existing UI sticker outline reference. Add one thick uniform solid pure black outer outline at the same thickness as image 2, about 48px on a 1024px square. Follow the entire silhouette with smooth edges. Keep the complete object centered with even transparent margins. Retain actual transparent RGBA outside the silhouette and in any large open gaps. No interior black strokes, drop shadow, glow spilling into transparency, panels, lettering, new features, or background.
